text: {"translations":{"fr":"Tbarkallah, mon fils, tu es devenu un homme !","es":"¡Tbarkallah, hijo mío, te has convertido en todo un hombre!","it":"Tbarkallah, figlio mio, sei diventato un uomo!","en":"Tbarkallah, my son, you've become a man!"},"feeling":["pride","love"],"cultural_notes":[{"expression":"tbarkallah 3lik","literal":"God's blessing is upon you","meaning":"Well done—I'm proud of you; an expression of admiration that also wards off envy."}],"confidence":"high"}

text: {"translations":{"fr":"Merci infiniment, tu m’as apporté le médicament.","es":"Muchísimas gracias, me trajiste la medicina.","it":"Grazie di cuore, mi hai portato la medicina.","en":"Thank you so much for bringing me the medicine."},"feeling":["gratitude"],"cultural_notes":[{"expression":"lah yr7em walidik","literal":"May God have mercy on your parents.","meaning":"A heartfelt way to say thank you so much; it does not mean the parents are dead."}],"confidence":"high"}

text: {"translations":{"fr":"Heureuse que tu sois arrivée sans encombre, ma fille. Dieu merci, tu es bien arrivée.","es":"Me alegra que hayas llegado bien, hija mía. Gracias a Dios, llegaste sin ningún problema.","it":"Sono contenta che tu sia arrivata sana e salva, figlia mia. Grazie a Dio, sei arrivata bene.","en":"I’m glad you made it safely, my daughter. text: {"translations":{"fr":"Vas-y, que Dieu t’aide, et n’oublie pas d’appeler ta mère.","es":"Ve, que Dios te ayude, y no olvides llamar a tu madre.","it":"Vai, che Dio ti aiuti, e non dimenticare di chiamare tua madre.","en":"Go on, may God help you, and don’t forget to call your mother."},"feeling":["blessing","care"],"cultural_notes":[],"confidence":"high"}
